summaries.en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.
summaries.zh: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
